payload.text: [session handover 2026-10-25] STATE: Bounded slice basicly-ejg4jyk is integrated on main and closed by the manual harness loop. This parent stays open. CAUSE: the installed dispatcher supplied UV_PYTHON=>=3.14, PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 while the CLI omitted them. Captured fingerprints differed only in these environment inputs. FIX: the reviewed pytest environment uses absent defaults from the existing hook_python policy on both execution and fingerprint paths; explicit overrides stay material. Cache engine identity also binds that policy source. EVIDENCE: regression fails before the fix; 112 focused checks pass; forcing defaults over explicit choices fails six controls. Seventeen installed-wheel CLI controls pass, including a cold run, no-cache, tracker-only reuse, changed source failure, configuration, dependencies, environment, unsupported interpreter launcher, malformed evidence, unsupported command and staged mode. Installed consumer CLI-to-hook proof passes with its fresh check executed. Required uv run basicly verify --mode full passes on the integrated candidate: 7775 ordinary cases passed, three skipped and one expected failure; all 185 fresh cases passed. Installed source hook reuses pytest and executes the other 41 checks. Its measured wall time is 225.49s before to 101.52s after; waited user plus system CPU is 561.26s to 212.16s. Cold source CLI wall is 227.19s before and 292.68s after, so no cold-run improvement is claimed. A real tracker-only push to a local bare remote passes and reuses the same pytest evidence: verification 102.188s, whole push 123.39s wall and 301.02s CPU including local transfer. No external publication occurred. LIMITS: single samples, host load uncontrolled; no arbitrary-command, cross-checkout, cross-platform or billed-token savings claim. Compiler equivalence is outside this pytest slice. DATA: all 14895 original events remain and the original 20693059 bytes are an exact prefix; inventory follows events-*.jsonl and pending-*.jsonl, excluding the derived snapshot. Existing regression worktree is unchanged. Task worktree was cleaned by the loop after its generated outputs were preserved. ARTIFACTS: .basicly/usage/reuse-slice contains raw CLI/hook logs, timing, invalidation controls, measured reports and the candidate wheel. RETRO: use the versioned local Lefthook archive directory; activate the consumer environment and preserve PATH ordering; count only authoritative event inventories. USAGE: host snapshot reports 217244 tokens and 2205 seconds for this goal; this is not a billed-token saving. NEXT: no required work remains for this bounded slice; broader parent acceptance remains open.
